verdict.rationale: The collection ships an official skill-creator meta-skill, described as "a skill for creating new skills and iteratively improving them". It covers creating, modifying, and measuring skills, including benchmarking with variance analysis and description optimization for triggering accuracy. A template SKILL.md is also provided. A runtime probe confirmed skill-creator installs cleanly from the repo. missing for 10: evidence that the meta-skill guides packaging/distribution of new skills (plugin packaging is documented only as a separate manual workflow), hands-on corroboration of actually using skill-creator to author or improve a skill.
